Nadia: Heads-up: CompactStream is GA today for Hosted API. Its a hybrid streaming endpoint that returns interleaved text + lightweight embeddings for each sentence chunk. Opt-in via Console > Endpoints. :tada:

Rohit: Ooh nice. Is this targeted at search + chat combos?

Nadia: Exactly. Typical wins for multi-turn assistants and semantic indexing during generation. Median end-to-end latency down ~30% for 1-3 sentence responses.

Sam: What are the breaking changes vs embed-stream?

Nadia: New endpoint `/v1/compact/stream`. Payload changes: `emit_embeddings=true` toggles the interleaved embedding frames. Theres a new header `X-Compact-Mode` with values `balanced|throughput|realtime`. embed-stream will be deprecated in 75 days; we will auto-route only for customers that opt in. Full migration guide in the docs.

Elena: Ops note 30 canary rollout scheduled. I added a checklist to the infra runbook and a synthetic that validates both text frames and embedding vectors.

infra-bot: infra-bot: rollout/compactstream-ga: initiated (canary clusters: us-west-1, eu-west-1) at 2723456900. canary_replicas=4.

Rohit: SDK impact? Any breaking changes in JS/py libs we should be aware of?

Nadia: Patch releases out now. JS: response frames include `frame_type` ("text"|"embedding"). Py: generators yield a tuple (frame_type, payload). We added helper util `compact.flatten_frames()` to collapse text+embeds for consumers.

Sam: Example curl for support docs?

Nadia: Quick example:

Nadia: ```bash
Nadia: curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
Nadia:   -H "X-Compact-Mode: realtime" \
Nadia:   -d '{"model":"cstream-small-1","emit_embeddings":true,"packet_window":16}' \
Nadia:   https://api.redwood.ai/v1/compact/stream
Nadia: ```

infra-bot: infra-bot: rollout/compactstream-ga: canary health=green (2723456925).

Elena: Monitoring: added metrics for embedding drift (cosine baseline), frame-order latency, and packet_window saturation. Alert thresholds in the new CompactStream dashboard.

Rohit: Quotas / billing model?

Nadia: Billing: CompactStream uses `bytepack` units (packets * bytes) instead of plain token counts. Default quota: 15 rps, 600 bytepack/min. Customers can request increases via Console.

Sam: Any known ETA on when itll be available in Dedicated?

Nadia: Dedicated support planned for next month (preview). Private deployments require an agent update; well publish the operator bundle next week.

Elena: I posted the migration checklist and troubleshooting playbook in the Docs repo: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/compactstream-migration

Nadia: Town hall today 4pm PT to demo frames and show SDK snippets. Please RSVP.

Rohit: I'll update customer-facing release notes and ping key beta partners.

infra-bot: rollout/compactstream-ga: proceeding to global regions (2723456950).

Nadia: Thanks team 30 watch #eng-runtime for regressions and tag me for escalations. :rocket:
